caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate wall fixture featuring a rectangular mirror set within a decorative frame. The frame is predominantly yellow with brown streaks, giving it a wood grain appearance. It is heavily embellished with floral and leaf motifs, particularly around the top, bottom, and sides, and has a symmetrical, curvilinear outline with three rounded accents on the top edge. The rectangular mirror is bordered by a red inner frame and a thicker brown outer frame. Attached to both sides of the bottom portion of the frame are candle holders that extend outward, each shaped like a cup and supported by elaborate scrollwork in brown. The fixture is centrally placed on a plain cream background, and the artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Mirror
